text: “Excuse me, gentlemen,—this compartment is reserved.” “I am a journalist, Monsieur, engaged on the ‘Epoque,’” said my young friend with a great show of gesture and politeness, “and I have a word or two to say to Monsieur de Marquet.” “Monsieur is very much engaged with the inquiry he has in hand.” “Ah! his inquiry, pray believe me, is absolutely a matter of indifference to me. I am no scavenger of odds and ends,” he went on, with infinite contempt in his lower lip, “I am a theatrical reporter; and this evening I shall have to give a little account of the play at the Scala.” “Get in, sir, please,” said the Registrar. Rouletabille was already in the compartment. I went in after him and seated myself by his side.
